item.title: [ANALYSIS] [News] Ransomware Attack Disrupts Multiple Systems at Japanese Semiconductor Supplier
item.description: TOKYO, Japan – February 19, 2026 – Advantest Corporation (TSE: 6857), a leading supplier of semiconductor test equipment, revealed it is tackling a ransomware incident that impacted parts of its IT network.
item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Review incident response procedures and notification timelines

item.title: [ANALYSIS] [Publication] India's 2026 Amendment To IT Rules: Regulation Of Deepfakes, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Content And The Three-Hour Takedown Regime - New Technology - India
item.description: The amendment, effective from 20 February 2026, represents a significant development in India's digital regulatory sphere by expressly addressing deepfakes and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated content.2
item.content:encoded:

item.title: [ANALYSIS] [News] India Tightens Rules on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Media
item.description: Effective February 20, 2026, the rules mandate that any “synthetically generated information” appearing photorealistic or true-to-life must carry a prominent label and traceable metadata.
